context: A chef and barista plan an event
purpose: Teach: リュック/コスメ/さんま/琵琶湖/ライトアップ/待ち遠しい/リベンジ/新居

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、テーマパーク連動企画、リュック特典、つけよか。
lines.en: Aoi-san, should we add the theme-park collab backpack as a bonus item?
lines.style: Energetic Kansai warmth. Quick, decisive cadence. Leaning forward with enthusiasm. Light-hearted proposal, expecting buy-in.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。コスメブランドとも、コラボ進めましょう。
lines.en: Yes. Let's move forward with the cosmetics-brand collab too.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, already thinking ahead. Measured pace. Nodding slightly as she speaks. Professional but genuinely interested.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 秋メニュー、さんま塩焼き、定番にしよ。
lines.en: For autumn, let's make the salt-grilled sanma a permanent menu item.
lines.style: Practical confidence. Measured, assured tone. Knows this will work. No hesitation on the decision.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 琵琶湖近くのリゾートと、提携、興味あります。
lines.en: Actually, I'm interested in a partnership with a resort near Lake Biwa.
lines.style: Bright and thoughtful. Slight lift at the end of the phrase. She's been thinking about this. Genuinely curious about his reaction.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 冬の店舗、ライトアップ、ええなあ。
lines.en: The winter store lighting campaign — that's going to look really good.
lines.style: Appreciative but grounded. Warm undertone. Picturing it clearly. The satisfaction of a detail coming together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 年末セール、待ち遠しい、お客様、多いです。
lines.en: A lot of customers are looking forward to the year-end sale.
lines.style: Bright, observational tone. Speaking from what she's noticed in recent weeks. Positive but not performed.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 去年売り切れた商品、リベンジで、増産しよ。
lines.en: Let's do a bigger production run on the items that sold out last year — make up for it.
lines.style: Light competition in the tone. Friendly resolve. The 'revenge' framing brings a slight playful edge. Still practical.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新居祝いのギフトセット、強化します。
lines.en: We'll strengthen our new-home gift sets — that's a big category for us.
lines.style: Warm closing thought. Confident, looking forward. Gentle but clear priority. The voice of someone who's noticed what matters to customers.
